description: Binary sources for the floating-point M1–M5 dispatch models. Absolute virtual addresses are unslid Mach-O addresses. Timings are not inputs to the selection. The 26 and 27 model profiles refer to these captured builds, not all future builds with that major version.

temporary_buffer_policy.evidence: All three getters are immediate-value mov/ret bodies in each captured MPSCore binary. Native encoder workspaces capture resourceOptions=544 (private, tracked, default CPU cache).
temporary_buffer_policy.lifetime: MPSAutoBuffer defers allocation through MPSAutoCache::GetTempBuffer and returns temporary resources through ReleaseTempResource after the final encoded use. Distinct objects may reuse a GPU virtual address.
temporary_buffer_policy.runtime: metalblas/native/submission.mm uses the private exported Get/Return command-buffer-cache wrappers for encoder workspaces. The native heap allocator is reused, not independently reimplemented. The cache owns these objects; the caller does not objc_release them.
temporary_buffer_policy.scope: Encoder workspaces use the private cache. Graph intermediates now follow the separately recovered MPSGraph policy recorded in graph_intermediate_policy.

identity_behavior_parameters.description: Apple constructor stores packed NX parameters at behavior+8. Low three bits apply at Y<=4096, upper bits at Y>4096; either extent<128 forces one result.

MPSGraph.scope: Command-buffer reference model in tools/mps_submission_model.py. The ordinary public-operation subset is integrated in metalblas/mps_submission.py and metalblas/native/submission.mm; general graph splitting and the global GPU-region override remain unsupported.

encode_count_lifecycle.registration_order: Scheduled before MPSRuntime::evaluateOps; completed after it. A region submission can place the handlers on different root command buffers.

compiler_regions.condition: A non-null Metal GPU device and either compiler-options bit 11 or the separate global override. Level 0 clears bit 7 only.
compiler_regions.validation: 51 native public calls with matching compiled masks and topology; this is a captured OS/compiler default, not a GPU-core threshold.

MPSGraph.statistics_accounting: Recursive walk excludes children of StitchedOp. Ordinary eligible operations contribute output elements. MemrefBackedOp itself is excluded; its nested operations are still visited.

disabled_commit_and_continue.evidence: The base virtual method consists of mov w0, #0; ret. The encoding callback advances counters only when enableCommitAndContinue or dynamic changes is true.
disabled_commit_and_continue.scope: Ordinary serial EncodeDescriptor. Parallel BlockingEncodeDescriptor has a separate dynamic policy and is not modeled by the disabled-mode helper.
disabled_commit_and_continue.validation: M2/macOS 26.3, M3 Ultra/macOS 26.5.2 and M5 Pro/macOS 27.2: 45 native/source pairs each across normal, early/late Signpost tracing, capture-enabled and active-capture modes. All descriptor writes and commit counts match in the default-runtime integration.

graph_intermediate_policy.scope: The single static dense intermediate in public addbmm with batch > 1; no arbitrary MLIR graph bufferization is implemented.
graph_intermediate_policy.selection: Use the actual execution descriptor compilerOptions bit 14, with selector availability as a compatibility guard. No device-generation, OS-version, shape-timing or latency threshold selects storage.
graph_intermediate_policy.legacy_path: GPURegionRuntime::allocateTensorDataForValue creates MPSTemporaryNDArray for this ephemeral graph result; the port uses MPSCore Get/Return cache wrappers for its backing buffer.
graph_intermediate_policy.runtime: The native program marks graph-result storage separately from encoder workspaces. Shared placement buffers are retained per executable and Metal command queue; scheduled/completed handlers preserve their owner through GPU completion.

code_identity.method: objdump --macho -d of each dyld-extracted binary; per-symbol instruction streams compared after removing load addresses, adrp page numbers and page-relative immediates (scratch tools normdis.py/classify.py).
code_identity.MPSNDArray: All 2,350 common functions identical, including all 336 matmul/vector/identity/reduction/LoRA functions.
code_identity.MPSGraph: All 85,232 common functions identical (submission, region formation, executable, compilation descriptor and MatMulOpHandler paths included).
code_identity.tables: LORA_SIMDS/ROWS/UNROLL and identity Apple records re-read at the mapped addresses; values equal the 26.5.2 snapshot.
code_identity.shaders: mmul_kernel_a16_{float,half,bfloat}, NDArrayVectorMatrixMultiply_{1_4,5_8,9_12,13_16}, LORADOWN_gemv_kernel, ndArrayIdentity[Transpose], NDArrayMatrixMultiplyReduction and reduce_multiple_passes_axes_add AIR are identical after metal-opt -S and metadata/type-suffix normalization.

parallel_descriptor_defaults.maximum_field_condition: Used by the pass only when the separate global override is enabled; otherwise the pipeline takes its maximum from global configuration.

MPSGraph.statistics_accounting: Recursive walk excludes children of StitchedOp. Ordinary eligible operations contribute output elements. MemrefBackedOp contributes the recursive byte-weighted sum, and its nested operations are also visited. Encoding counters use the unweighted path.

parallel_submission_calls.scope: Call sites verified by disassembly and native stacks for the three captured two-child chain graphs. General splitting/scheduling is not modeled.

graph_intermediate_policy.source_gate: applyOptimizationPassesWithDevice checks a Metal device and compilerOptions bit 14 at 0x2212fb978, then walks isModuleMemrefRegionCompatible before creating the memref region pass. The type predicate rejects list types and unsupported dynamic shapes; the fixed public addbmm plan is static and dense.
graph_intermediate_policy.view_rounding: ViewMemrefOpHandler constructor 0x2212547d4..0x221254824 obtains getMemrefSizeInBytes, calls heapBufferSizeAndAlignWithLength:options: with options 0, and computes ceil(size / align) * align for the view length. The heap creation repeats the device alignment query. No alignment size is hard-coded.
graph_intermediate_policy.causal_validation: Calling setEnableMemrefBufferization:false before Torch initialization clears bit 0x4000 (0x31cd0f -> 0x318d0f). Native MPS and the source port switch from persistent shared placement storage to private temporary storage and retain correct outputs.
graph_intermediate_policy.limitations: The full fused-allocation planner, residency sets and cloned-heap idle reclamation are not ported. Recovered native cloned-queue idle interval is 5000000000 ns; this value is evidence only and is not an implementation parameter.
